plugins.name: gtg
plugins.description: Got to Go - pause/resume framework for Claude Code: say 'gtg' to write a handoff before you leave, 'let's continue X' to resume cold days later. Extend with your own commands and hooks.

plugins.name: due-diligence
plugins.description: Due Diligence — adversarial pre-ship review + build-to-standard construction (cdd): a modular 44-lens framework you extend with your own lenses to fit your work.

plugins.name: logical-research
plugins.description: Logical Research — turn a bounded corpus (a channel, a book, a doc set) into reusable context: a synthesis with evidence-graded claims, per-item notes, and a traceable bibliography. Extend it with your own reading angles.

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: projects — the portfolio layer: a generated index of everything you have going, one narrative page per project, and a sync that checks every row against reality instead of trusting a table a model maintained.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: learn — self-directed learning sprints on any subject: pick a track, build something real, and let a graded mastery gate decide whether you advance or repeat. Bring your own track for anything the built-in two do not cover.

plugins.name: postman
plugins.description: postman - real outbound email from your own mailboxes: address verification before anything sends, byte-exact signatures it never regenerates, and replies resolved live against the mailbox so they thread onto the existing conversation. Bring your own identities and your own secret store.
